title: oppo-health MCP tools
description: Machine-readable contract for the oppo-health MCP server (server/mcp_server.py, stdio transport). Any MCP client can connect and call these tools.
sink_db: sink/health.db (SQLite, WAL; every column TEXT + __row_hash UNIQUE + __t int-ms)

tools.name: health_ingest
tools.description: Ingest incremental data as sectioned CSV ('===TABLE:<t>|TIMECOL:<col>===' + header + rows, multiple sections allowed). Idempotent by row hash; updates per-table watermark. Returns {tables, new_rows, dup_skipped, watermark}.

tools.name: health_watermark
tools.description: Read current per-table watermark (max synced timestamp in ms). Rediscovered when incremental syncing.

tools.name: health_list_tables
tools.description: List all ingested tables with row counts.

tools.name: health_query
tools.description: Query ingested rows of a table. columns defaults to '*' (all valid columns). since/until filter __t in ms. limit capped at 5000. Columns are validated against the table's real schema.

tools.name: health_schema
tools.description: Show column structure of an existing table.

security: All table/column identifiers are validated against ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ and, for queries, must exist on the target table. All values are bound parameters. This blocks SQL injection — preserve this contract in any modification.

data_format.notes: Header immediately follows the ====== line; trailing '===' must be stripped before parsing so TIMECOL is clean; rows comma-separated; time_col is millisecond epoch used for watermark.
